## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have run `cargo fmt` and `cargo clippy` (if modifying Rust core/scanner)

- [ ] I have verified the frontend simulator builds successfully (`npm run build`)
- [ ] I have updated the exploits documentation corresponding to my changes
- [ ] No private keys or secrets are committed
